name: Hellowork
verdict: French job platform owned by Groupe Télégramme, the independent Breton group renamed ADVENN in 2024 (Le Télégramme, Hellowork group, OC Sport), chaired by Edouard Coudurier. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: registry shows Hellowork as a SASU whose sole corporate officer (Président de SAS) is GROUPE TELEGRAMME; Advenn's governance page ties Hellowork group into Coudurier's independent family group. No state or fund stake found → none.
